title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
About the Role 
We are looking for an experienced and performance-driven Senior IT Recruiter with 3+ years of proven expertise in IT/Technical hiring. The ideal candidate should have strong end-to-end recruitment experience across niche and emerging technologies, with the ability to independently manage client requirements and deliver quality closures in a fast-paced environment.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle end-to-end IT recruitment lifecycle for domestic and/or international clients. Work on mid to senior-level technical requirements across multiple technologies. Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, job portals, Boolean search, networking, and referrals. Recruit for roles in Software Development, Cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cybersecurity, Product Engineering, and Emerging Technologies. Conduct detailed screening and technical validation of profiles. Coordinate interviews, negotiate offers, and ensure smooth onboarding. Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for ongoing and future requirements. Work closely with hiring managers/clients to understand technical expectations and hiring priorities. Maintain strong submission quality, turnaround time (TAT), and closure ratios. Mentor junior recruiters when required and contribute to team performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 3-4 years of experience in IT/Technical recruitment.  Strong expertise in sourcing using advanced Boolean search techniques. Hands-on experience in hiring for niche and critical tech stacks. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills. Strong ability to work in a target-driven, deadline-oriented environment. Experience in handling multiple requirements simultaneously. Immediate joiners or short notice candidates preferred.

Key Skills: IT Recruitment,IT Hiring,End to End Recruitment,Technical Recruitment,TA,Talent Acquisition,End To End,Technical
